mintAuthority.summary: BREAD is a pure 1:1 Gnosis Chain wrapper around native xDAI deposited into the Gnosis Savings xDAI ERC-4626 vault. Under the verified Bread.sol implementation, mint() wraps payable xDAI into WXDAI and deposits it into the savings vault before minting BREAD 1:1, burn() withdraws WXDAI from the savings vault and returns native xDAI 1:1, and claimYield() is capped at accrued savings surplus above totalSupply. Wrapper-local logic remains mutable without delay: the 5-of-10 Bread Cooperative Safe holds both the EIP-173 proxy admin slot and contract ownership, so replacement logic can alter the wrapper's economic bound. Base xDAI issuance is inherited from reviewed xdai-gnosis and is not duplicated as a direct BREAD controller.

controls.capDescription: Current Bread.sol implementation 0x3146b62466b76642127b9f4fe34fa7cd9968bf96 restricts mint() to 1:1 payable xDAI deposits into the Gnosis Savings xDAI vault and caps claimYield() at accrued savings surplus above totalSupply, while rescueToken() reverts on the savings vault token. However, the 5-of-10 Safe holds the EIP-173 proxy admin slot with zero timelock and can upgrade the proxy to arbitrary replacement logic, leaving the wrapper-local economic bound unbounded.

review.evidence: Pinned verification at Gnosis Chain block 49496158 (2026-11-27T13:02:20Z) establishes BREAD as a single-chain Gnosis wrapper backed 100.189% by Gnosis Savings xDAI vault shares (352,988.180660 WXDAI maxWithdraw vs 352,321.934828 BREAD totalSupply, with 666.245832 xDAI claimable surplus). Current Bread.sol enforces continuous 1:1 on-chain mechanical reconciliation between BREAD liabilities and Savings xDAI assets on every mint(), burn(), and claimYield(). However, the 5-of-10 Bread Cooperative Safe can upgrade the EIP-173 proxy with zero timelock, keeping economicCapSemantics unbounded with no prudential supervision. Inherited xDAI bridge issuance and governance remain reviewed under xdai-gnosis.
